crime: Every night, one prisoner sits at the lounge fireplace writing a letter to her mother, and at half past nine she burns it so the smoke can carry it home. {WITCH_NAME} is the one girl who stays with her every evening. She turns the lounge into a moonlit shore of her own imagining, with the hush of waves and the smell of salt, and the letter-writer waits for her hour on the hearth rug.
Just after nine one night, the girl invites her home for when they get out of prison. "My mother will lay out the spare futon for you."
{WITCH_NAME} was nine when her aunt folded her futon into the cupboard and set the baby's cot in its place. It had only ever been the spare. She has slept nowhere but spare places since.
At ten past nine, as the girl kneels at the fire, {WITCH_NAME} takes the crossbow from the wall and shoots her in the back.
At half past nine, walking with the other prisoners to the cells, she lays the smell of burning paper behind the shut lounge door.
At ten to ten, the girl's roommate finds her dead by the fire with a bolt in her back.
In the trial court, the prisoners rule that she was shot after burning her letter, while {WITCH_NAME} was walking with them.
Then the roommate finds that day's letter in the dead girl's pocket, unburnt, written before she ever came to the fire: "Air the spare futon. I'm bringing her home."
The prisoners understand. Nothing burned at half past nine. The smell came from a place {WITCH_NAME} imagined.
fields.epitaph: She was expected all along: someone had already kept her a place, and she stopped the letter that said so.
execution: The execution stand lays her on her back on a long, iron-weighted futon and straps her down beside an open iron cupboard.
The futon rolls up from her feet, winding her inside like bedding being put away.
As the roll climbs past her chest, she lays her moonlit shore over the trial court.
The stand shuts the rolled futon in the iron cupboard, and the moonlit shore goes out.

magic.name: Anywhere But Here
magic.text: She can wrap the place around her in the sights, sounds and smells of anywhere she imagines.
